topicTitle: Pakistan in ECO, the EU and the SCO

topicTitle: The United Nations and Global Welfare
title: Elaborate the significance of the UN's role in promoting the welfare of developing and conflict-affected countries in terms of addressing issues related to human rights, religious freedom, peacekeeping, access to food and healthcare, education, poverty reduction, and economic progress.
